label: EXPLORATORY: L1 Turnover Penalty Regularization
note: Not pre-registered (PREREGISTRATION.md §8); lambda_tc chosen after results were seen. lambda_tc = 0 is the pre-registered model and reproduces results/results.json.
formulation: min 1/2 w'Sw - mu'w + lambda_tc*||w - w_prev||_1 s.t. sum(w)=1, 0<=w<=W_CAP, CVaR_alpha(w) <= CVaR_alpha(EW); w_prev = previous solution drifted to the decision date
